تستقبحوا (form X)
# تَسْتَقْبِحُوا (tastaqbiḥū) /tas.taq.bi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
# تُسْتَقْبَحُوا (tustaqbaḥū) /tus.taq.ba.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَقْبَحَ (istaqbaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
